title: The Final Duel
description: Cad Bane and Boba Fett. Two of the most notorious bounty hunters in the galaxy. Their names alone are enough to strike fear in the hearts of any ne'er-do-well with a price on their head. The two of them decided to settle their decades-long grudge with an old-fashioned quick draw shootout and ensuing melee. In the calm before the draw, the two of them had last words with each other, as much taunting as wrapping up the long threads of their relationship and shared history. The moments before the draw left them both wondering who would be faster...
